claims.quote: "Across a decade," she said, voice crisp in the hush, "only three have been recorded as departing after ten years—Elaine, Maris, and Sal. Let their names stand in the Folio and in our memory as both testament and caution."
claims.value: The Three explicitly named and placed as institutional statistic at patron ceremony

claims.quote: "The ledger for this intake is closed and copied," the scribe announced... "A thin list will be kept for public record; the full Folio will be carried to the Archive for safekeeping."
claims.value: Folio for intake closed, copied; thin list kept publicly, full Folio archived

claims.quote: When her turn came she stood at the table and took the slips offered: three folded pieces of paper, each named and numbered.
claims.value: Rue took three apprentices and received slips as assignment markers
